newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada T-bills open softer ahead of weekly tender.
newsitem.headline: Canada T-bills open softer ahead of weekly tender.

text.p: Canadian T-bills opened softer on Tuesday ahead of the weekly T-bill tender, with a softer Canadian dollar and a decline in Canadian and U.S. fixed-income markets weighing on prices, analysts said.
"The dollar is getting a little bit weaker," said one T-bill trader with a bank-owned brokerage. "That's definitely spilling over into the bills and that's the story."
Canada's three-month when-issued T-bill softened to yield 3.0 percent from 2.97 percent at the close of trading on Monday.
